entities.name: Query protein CbiD
observations: 370 aa protein; calculated molecular mass 38.68 kDa and theoretical pI 6.32.
Exact full-length sequence hash match to reviewed UniProt Q4ZN23, a cobalt-precorrin-5B C(1)-methyltransferase.
Pfam domains: CbiD (PF01888) at residues 8-186 and CbiD_C (PF29030) at residues 274-361.

entities.name: Cobalt-precorrin-5B C1 methyltransferase
observations: Catalyzes methylation of cobalt-precorrin-5B at C-1 to produce cobalt-precorrin-6A.
Assigned EC 2.1.1.195 and Rhea reaction RHEA:26285.
Uses S-adenosyl-L-methionine as methyl donor, producing S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine.
Participates in the anaerobic adenosylcobalamin biosynthetic pathway, step 6 of 10 from sirohydrochlorin-derived intermediates.
GO molecular function: GO:0043780; biological process: GO:0019251.
